Definition: from G907; ablution (ceremonial or Christian):--baptism, washing.
BiblicalUsage: Baptismos covers washings of every kind. There is the Pharisees' washing of cups and pots and tables, the doctrine of baptisms listed among the first principles of the faith, the fleshly ordinances of the old covenant, and the burial with Christ in baptism that Paul says raises us with Him through faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the washing that matters is the one within, not the one without. The Pharisees washed their cups and missed their hearts, but Paul says true baptism buries us with Christ, and I hold that no amount of outward washing can do what that burial does.
